title: Rewinding the first work-tape head
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, and suppose $E$ has at least one work tape. Choose states $e_0,e_f$ of $E$ and $g_0,g_f$ of $G$, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean word. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j<|x|$, the machine constructed from $E$ and $G$, when in its tape-rewinding state with the input head at the right boundary blank and the first work-tape head at position $j$, takes one step to the same state and input-head position, with that work-tape head moved to position $j-1$; all other tape contents and head positions, as well as the output, are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ has at least one work tape
